engine: SAPIEN 3.0.3 / PhysX CPU, Vulkan llvmpipe; no engine change

physics.automatic_exception: PhysX immediate parent-child articulation links; list every pair in model_audit.json

controller.mimic: native SAPIEN loader fixed tendon; follower has zero drive stiffness, validate actual relation

camera.known_points: front face grid, at least 5 points
camera.depth: -Position.z in OpenGL camera, meters; background masked by Position.w<1; optical frame x right,y down,z forward; SAPIEN x forward,y left,z up
camera.fallback: same SAPIEN renderer through Mesa Vulkan software permitted; changing engine or robot structure requires report first

interface.GET /health: ready/error, API and model version, actual DOF counts, PID and physical step counters
interface.GET /model: actual loaded joint order, joint types, dimensions, axis/limits, effort and mimic relationships
interface.GET /state: left/right arm qpos/qvel/goal/drive target and independent left/right gripper driver/follower in meters; actual full 18-DOF vectors; epoch and current action
interface.POST /reset: empty object; priority barrier cancels old actions and stale queued targets; reinitializes model state, epoch increases; counters record actual steps
interface.POST /actions: nonempty subset left[7], right[7], left_gripper scalar, right_gripper scalar; optional epoch; radians for arms, meters per finger travel for grippers; unspecified side keeps previous GOAL; slew limits inherited; immediate 202 then asynchronous actual physics for 720 steps
interface.GET /actions/{id}: queued/running/completed/failed/stopped/canceled_reset/superseded; epochs, targets, actual steps and errors
interface.POST /stop: empty object; priority barrier cancels current and pre-barrier queued actions; goal/drive target becomes current bounded qpos, physics continues holding; epoch increases
interface.GET /observation: application/x-npz; RGB float32 [0,1], depth_m float32 optical Z meters, valid_depth mask, K, camera matrices, raw Position/Segmentation, frame step/epoch
interface.GET /collisions: actual current contact bodies/points/normals/negative separation/impulses; no global self collision disable

execution.cadence: 240 Hz wall-clock target; no realtime throughput claim
execution.completion: after actual 720 steps require arm/finger convergence AND final velocities within original Phase 0 tolerances; otherwise failed
execution.stop_reset: responses only after simulation thread commits barrier; previous epoch cannot modify later targets
execution.threading: HTTP handler threads enqueue; single simulation thread owns SAPIEN
execution.observation_physics_consistency: single-owner capture at stated step; queries do not set qpos
execution.lifecycle: supervisor owns process group; TERM wait 5s then KILL; startup 30s; each client run timeout 180s; SIGTERM graceful shutdown

tests.baseline_sequence: 480 settle then original five 720-step commands, >=4080 actual steps per start
per_start_required: mimic every reported phase and full trajectory
RGB-D/K/pose with 5 known points per observation
collision known overlap and separated control via real simulation startup probes + HTTP reporting
invalid finite/bounds/dimension requests leave epoch/goal/action unchanged
stop in executing action then 240-step hold and no old command
reset in executing action cancels old epoch then 240-step hold
lifecycle_extra: unhandled native-process exception injection and reap
tests.client: real urllib HTTP to independently spawned local service, no mocks
tests.freeze_rule: No tolerance/count/action relaxation; preserve failures and fully rerun after fixes
